name: ESCAPE
source:
Majima Yamato is a typical high school student. Despite being only in second year of HS, he is living on his own since he couldn't get along with his new step-father. His mother showed no love towards him and his relationship with his kind, older step-brother was awkward. He has been alone for a while. However, there are alot of people out there and a new school year is also starting. Depending on your choice, maybe he will find a new love.....

[From: Aarinfantasy Forums]
translation:
真岛大和是一名典型的高中生。尽管他才读高中二年级，但由于与新继父合不来，他只能独自生活。他的母亲对他没有表现出任何爱，他和他善良的继兄的关系也很尴尬。他已经独自一人有一段时间了。然而，那里有很多人，新学年也开始了。根据你的选择，也许他会找到新的爱情……
